description: CasaOS - A simple, easy-to-use, elegant open-source Personal Cloud system.

summary.one_liner: CasaOS is an open-source, home-focused personal cloud operating system for running a self-hosted server on low-cost hardware such as ZimaBoard, Intel NUC, or Raspberry Pi.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a web UI designed for home use that handles drive and file management, system and app status widgets showing resource usage, and one-click installation of apps from a curated app store (examples named: Nextcloud, HomeAssistant, AdGuard, Jellyfin, and *arr apps). It also says users can install Docker apps from the wider Docker ecosystem. Installation is a one-line shell script run on a freshly installed supported Linux system, and updates can be done from the UI or a terminal. The README also states that the CLI provides a version command (casaos -v) and an uninstall command (casaos-uninstall, v0.3.3 or newer). The README frames the project as a personal data center and a way to reduce reliance on SaaS, though it does not detail specific AI features beyond general statements.
use_cases: Run a home server on a Raspberry Pi or old PC
Self-host Nextcloud or Jellyfin at home
Manage files and drives through a web interface
Install Docker apps without using the command line
Monitor resource usage of a home server
Replace some cloud subscription services with local hosting
Run Home Assistant on a home network
how_to_run: Freshly install a supported system (Debian 12, Ubuntu Server 20.04, Raspberry Pi OS, or other listed distributions)
Run: wget -qO- <install-script-url> | sudo bash  (URL missing from README text)
Or run: curl -fsSL <install-script-url> | sudo bash  (URL missing from README text)
Update via Settings > Update in the UI, or re-run the install command from an SSH session
stack: Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, Raspberry Pi OS, CentOS, and others)
notable: Designed specifically for home scenarios, with a no-code, non-technical web UI
Curated one-click app store plus access to Docker Hub-style Docker app ecosystem
Runs on amd64, arm64, and armv7 hardware
Originated as the pre-installed system for the ZimaBoard crowdfunded product
Updatable from the UI or terminal
caveats: Several distributions (Alpine, OpenWrt, ArchLinux) are listed as not fully tested
Terminal-based updates must be run over SSH or a directly attached keyboard, not from the CasaOS UI terminal
Install and update script URLs are missing from the README text provided
